instruction.text: Wie sollte man bei der Vorbereitung einer Präsentation vorgehen? Sortiere die Schritte.

atoms.text: Choose a topic for your presentation.
Brainstorm some ideas for potential contents.
Look up suitable keywords in a search engine or literature.
Collect notes and structure them properly.
Practise giving your presentation with key cards.

atoms.b: For your research, use a variety of ((++objective subjective)), reliable and ((++up-to-date outdated)) sources. When taking notes, ensure to change the text into ((++your_own_words the_same_words)) to avoid ((++plagiarism citation)).

atoms.a: Which of the following scenarios is plagiarism? More than one answer can be correct.
b: ++Noah quotes a line from a website and doesn't state the source.
++Enna copies a thought from a text without giving the source.
Lyra uses an image from a textbook and cites the source.
Keno summarises a paragraph and gives the source of the text.

b.sound: In 2022, Germany has used up its resources for the entire year by July 28th. This Earth Overshoot Day highlights our unsustainable carbon footprint.
Today, I am going to present you a topic that is quite relevant for the future: smart cities.
Imagine your grandparents are being cared for... by a robot! This scenario is not as utopian as many of you might think.
Have you ever heard about the intelligent slime mold? This unicellular organism doesn't have a brain, however it is able to learn and make choices.

instruction.text: Übersetze die Aussagen einer Präsentation, indem du sie in die richtige Reihenfolge bringst. Entscheide danach, zu welchem Teil der Präsentation sie gehören.

atoms.a: „Zuerst werde ich euch eine kurze Definition geben, bevor ich einige verstärkende Faktoren vorstellen werde.“

instruction.text: Ordne nun die Aussagen den passenden Gliederungspunkten der Präsentation zu.

b.sound: Today, I am going to talk about a topic that directly connects to our daily lives and the health of our planet: The Carbon Footprint.

This brings me to the definition of the carbon footprint. It is a measure of the amount of emissions that are released by an action or process and is important to assess the climate impact of individuals, countries or even the whole world.
To conclude, I will now sum up the main points about the carbon footprint.
Thank you for your attention! Are there any questions? If not I would like to hear your assessment of your own carbon footprint.
